History rows are the mockup's kHist (kLive from SC.E plus kFixture's invented 21 months). The School books card's figures are the member and public KPI documents (src/fixtures/mart/documents.json, monthly-members). Run against the frozen mockup, atm dev 742105b64 (disclosure v2, PR #125), which also gives the gating texts (as=, the lock panel, 'Exit preview to act'); the audiences are Audience of src/data/disclosure.ts (S7), the disclosure object Disclosure of the same file.
notes: Routes: #/<school>/members?portal=<profileId>&portalTab=&siteTheme=&history=&historyAll=&as=. portal opens the member portal of that person (src/data/portal.ts memberPortal); portalTab is overview, bookings, billing or family (absent: overview); siteTheme is b4u, host or dark (absent: b4u, portal.ts siteThemes); history is all, this or last (absent: all, portal.ts historyRowsIn); historyAll=1 shows every history row (absent: the latest 5). as= is the shared audience parameter (public, member, governance, finance, owner; absent: the signed-in person's own); the portal reads it from the route and never writes it. The family switch changes portal= and keeps the other parameters; Exit and Escape (no dialog open) remove portal, portalTab, siteTheme, history and historyAll. A portal= with no such person shows the Members tab without a portal.

root.dataset.route is set once the portal of the route is on screen (or, when the tab is gated or there is no such person, once the pane shows what replaces it). While the portal is open the pane holds only the portal: the roster is not in the page, so page-wide absent lists hold for the member's view.

Data: src/data/portal.ts. The Reader gives memberPortal({ school, profileId }), one document scoped by the server (an adult: the family; a teen, a child or a family of one: their own); consistency check C5 reads it for every person: every people[].key is the viewed person's key and every booking and history row belongs to one of people. The School books card reads Reader.kpiDocument as PortalBooks says (an adult at member or public: the first preset, that level, unlocked; its last period shown for money). The Writer gives portalChangeQuantity, portalCancelMembership, portalResumeMembership and portalCancelBooking; Buy, Update, Open school books and Copy snippet write nothing and only toast (Copy snippet first puts embedSnippets().page on the clipboard).

Hooks: portal is the overlay (mockup #vm). Its preview bar: portal-viewing ('Viewing as <name>'), portal-id ('<profileId> · <school>'), portal-theme (the Site theme select; options in siteThemes order with their names), portal-family-switch (one button per family member, data-profile, the person's name as title, text Adult, Teen or Child, class 'on' for the viewed one; absent without a family), portal-embed ('Embed…'), portal-exit ('Exit'). portal-scope is the 'Members see only themselves and their family.' banner, portal-note the preview note. portal-frame is the member's view (mockup .mpf) with data-site-theme and the portalFrameVariables of its theme on its style; portal-header its header ('<school> Classes Schedule Shop <name>'); portal-tab its tabs (role tab, data-portal-tab, aria-selected, class 'on').

Overview: portal-plan is the plan card with portal-plan-name ('Shine ×2'), portal-plan-price ('$90.00 / month'), portal-plan-status (the pill: Active or 'Ends <date>'), portal-plan-line (the line under it), portal-plan-note (each note: 'Switches to <tier> ×<n> on <date>.', 'A change is on its way. It can take a few minutes.'; absent when there is none). portal-balance is the credits card with portal-available (the big number). books-card is the School books card with data-audience (the PortalBooks audience), books-pill and books-text; for member its figures are cells as in S1 ([data-kpi][data-period][data-cell], a hidden cell its label with title 'Hidden: <why>'). portal-addons is 'Need more <unit>?' (absent when the school sells none). portal-action is every button of the member's view with data-action quantity, cancel, resume, buy (with data-addon), card, books or cancel-booking (with data-booking); a disabled one carries its reason as title.

Bookings: portal-booking per booking of the viewed person (data-booking) with portal-booking-service and, instead of a button, portal-booking-status (Awaiting confirmation, Waiting for approval, 'Contact the school to cancel', 'waiting to ship'). Family: portal-family-note is the line above the cards, portal-family-card one card per person (data-profile) with its portal-available. portal-empty is an empty state ('No upcoming bookings.', 'No family on this account. You see only your own <unit> and bookings.').

Billing: portal-next-invoice and portal-payment-method are the first two cards; history-card is 'Invoices and payments' with history-count ('Showing <shown> of <all>, newest first'), history-period (the period select), history-download (Download CSV, title 'Download this history as CSV', disabled with title 'Finance admins only' unless the viewer's audience is finance or owner, and disabled when the period has no row), history-group (a month heading row, '<Mon> <yyyy>'), history-row (data-profile) with history-date ('Nov 3, 2026'), history-description, history-member (the person's name, only in an adult's family view), history-amount (money with a U+2212 minus for a refund) and history-status (the label), and history-more ('Show all history (<n>)' or 'Show latest 5', absent with 5 rows or fewer). A download builds the file with the shared CSV helper of src/data/ledger.ts (S5) from historyCsvColumns and historyCsvFileName, then toasts 'Downloaded <n> rows' (see csv).

Dialogs (shared with S2): dialog is the modal, dialog-title, dialog-preview (the mockup's #vpv line), dialog-confirm and dialog-cancel its buttons; quantity-select is Change amount's select (options '<n>' and '<n> (current)'), cancel-reason Cancel membership's textarea. The embed modal is a dialog with embed-snippet (data-step page, server, theme, books: the pre blocks of embedSnippets), embed-books-audience (the Document select: every audience, only public enabled and selected), embed-origins (the Allowed sites input, starting at embedAllowedSitesDefault), embed-copy and embed-done. Escape closes an open dialog; with none open it closes the portal. toast is the shell's toast (shared with S2). lock-panel is the shared lock panel (data-lock, the v2 lockPanel heading and line).

Writes: the dialog closes when the request is sent; while it is pending the plan card shows 'A change is on its way. It can take a few minutes.' and disables Change amount, Cancel membership and Resume membership (a booking shows 'waiting to ship' instead of its button); the toast and the change itself ('Switches to …', 'Ends <date>', Active) show when the Writer answers. Previewing an audience other than one's own (as= below one's own) disables every write and hand-off button except Open school books, title 'Exit preview to act' (mockup pvLock).
Selects (portal-theme, history-period, quantity-select) react to the input event, as the runner's fill step sends it.

moves: a text marked moves is checked again through a Reader whose moves.fields are changed by the holdout factor (protocol §7; numbers multiplied, strings changed); it must exist, pass the absent list and differ.

Not mapped (no field, route or reachable state): the increase preview of Change amount ('Charged now: $56.33 (26 of 30 days left in this cycle). Adds 14 sessions now.' is the server's proration, no route yet) and its toast; the 'refund pending' pill (no fixture row has a pending refund); the history empty state ('Nothing in this period', 'No invoices or payments in this period.': every mockup person has rows in every period) and Download CSV disabled for a non-finance admin (no as= value is an admin without the finance grant; the mockup's smoke flips Jo A.'s grant); the Members row's eye button that opens the portal (S4's roster hook; entries open the portal by route); the toast's Undo; the tier-audience notice ('What members can see changed on 5 Nov 2026', data-audchg: no fixture tier changed its audience); the history's 'Finance only' amounts for an admin without the finance grant (the mockup's school har, not one of the app's schools).

csv.note: For the builder's test/s6 (not run by the golden runner): the downloads of the matrix people, from the mockup headless (kPortalCsv, kCsv, kName).
